verdict.rationale: Puzzle advertises 'AI Close Agents' and an 'AI Close' feature for month-end close automation, plus AI-driven categorization/batch review that a user reviews before finalizing, suggesting some automated close-time oversight. However, there is no explicit evidence of an agent proactively flagging spend anomalies or duplicate transactions as a distinct capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of anomaly detection, duplicate-transaction flagging, and independent/hands-on confirmation that AI Close performs these checks before close.
